sources.entry: ManageMeals - Manage recipes, import recipes by URL and organize them without any ads or unnecessary text. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: ManageMeals Web is the SvelteKit frontend for the ManageMeals recipe manager, which needs a separate backend to run.
summary.what_it_does: This repository contains the web frontend for ManageMeals, a recipe management app, and is built with SvelteKit. Development mode requires the backend to be running and a .env file copied from an example template. Production builds are handled by a Dockerfile, and the README describes running several web instances behind a load balancer via docker-compose with port mappings in an override file. The README does not describe the recipe features in detail; the awesome-selfhosted listing describes it as managing recipes, importing recipes by URL, and organizing them without ads.
use_cases: running a recipe app in Docker
notable: Frontend only; requires the separate ManageMeals backend to run
Docker-based production setup with a load balancer and multiple web instances
Listed on awesome-selfhosted under Recipe Management
Recipes can be imported by URL, according to the awesome-selfhosted listing
caveats: Requires the ManageMeals backend to be running; this repo alone is not a complete app
README is brief and gives no feature list or screenshots
Production setup assumes docker-compose and Make
